help_graphics_modes.title: Graphics modes
help_graphics_modes.integrated: Integrated GPU only. Lower power draw and longer battery life. The discrete (NVIDIA) GPU is not used.
help_graphics_modes.hybrid: Uses both GPUs. Integrated for display by default; NVIDIA when an application requests it. Good balance of performance and battery.
help_graphics_modes.nvidia: NVIDIA discrete GPU as primary. Best graphics and gaming performance; higher power draw.
help_graphics_modes.compute: Like Integrated for display (everything rendered on integrated), but NVIDIA remains available for compute (CUDA, ML, etc.) without driving the display.
help_graphics_modes.reboot_note: A reboot is required after changing the mode.
